title: Brothers and Sisters in the Lord
author: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
author_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

footnotes.text: For two blind men sitting by the wayside (seeMatthew 20:30–34), a faith-filled leper (seeMark 1:40–41), a man Jesus delivered of an unclean spirit (seeMark 5:2–19), the Savior had compassion and healed each one. And when Jesus “saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them,” He sent them forth only after He had fed them with a few loaves and fishes (seeMatthew 14:14, 23). Our Savior’s deep compassion is likewise evident in His parables about the forgiving king, good Samaritan, and prodigal son (seeMatthew 18:27, 33;Luke 10:33;15:20).
